5. Martinus Lutherus, lib. de Votis
monasticis, de obedientia Monachorum;
Peccant hic eadem insania Monastici, qua & in
paupertatem. Primo quod consilium eam fa-
ciunt: deinde quod solis sibi arrogant. Ideo dum
eam vouent, & impie negant mandatum De-
i, & sacrilege damnant votum Baptismi sui. Si vero
aliqui pie vouent, nonnisi corporalem vouent. At
nisi Spiritus in eis fit, & tandem alijs quoq; subdat,
nihil vouetur, nisi contrarium Euangelicæ obedi-
entiæ. Inter omnia vota monastica nullum est mi-
nus substantiale, quam obedientiæ votum. Igitur
fiat conclusio. Obedientiam Monasticam, esse ru-
dem, & puerilem obedientiam pro rudimento
dumtaxat iuuentutis institutam, nec aliter
apud Deum acceptam, nec aliter voueri possi-
bilem, nisi impiam, & sacrilegam facere velis.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "præci-[?]pit" (line-end hyphen, letters partly unclear); "misericordie[?]" (word end obscured at the line break). "Fiat" in the conclusion and "Igitur" are read from a worn spot. "dum eam" and "alijs quoq;" are as printed. Running head absent. Page opens mid-division, so no heading.
